subject.title: fix(codex): keep progress replies from ending active turns

question: Should Codex `message_tool_only` turns permanently require model-supplied `final=true` for confirmed source delivery to end the turn, or should confirmed delivery remain implicitly terminal with prompt steering only?
rationale: Both designs address the reproduced premature-progress termination, but they establish incompatible model/runtime contracts and different failure behavior when the model omits the new optional field.

options.title: Adopt explicit final intent
options.body: Select this structural contract, require confirmed current-source delivery plus `final=true`, and explicitly own the omitted-flag compatibility behavior.

options.title: Preserve implicit completion
options.body: Keep confirmed current-source delivery terminal and select the narrower prompt-only mitigation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100156.

options.title: Select the successor
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105365 only after it gains equivalent exact-head real behavior proof and is confirmed as the preferred structural branch.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit final intent
recommendation.body: Select this structural contract, require confirmed current-source delivery plus `final=true`, and explicitly own the omitted-flag compatibility behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the current receipt-confirmed completion behavior being reconsidered.
